cells.title: What evidence does each of three UNCTAD reports from May 23, 2026 record?
cells.takeaway: Each report adds evidence to the one before: all three [[match UNCTAD's address|card:a1608f64#address%20match/22:12:54]], the second is also [[on the outside list|card:a1608f64#outside%20list/22:13:07]] and [[uses an intermediary|card:a1608f64#intermediary/22:13:07]], and only the third, which also [[contains code|card:a1608f64#code/22:13:20]], is rated [[significant|card:a1608f64#confidence/22:13:20]].
cells.code:
import pandas as pd
r = pd.read_csv('all-reports.csv', dtype=str).fillna('')
r['row'] = range(1, len(r) + 1)
src = pd.read_csv('report-sources.csv', dtype=str).set_index('report_id')
rows = r[r.row.isin([18989, 18990, 18991])]
print('rows', rows.row.tolist(), 'sources', rows.report_id.map(src.data_source).tolist())
has = lambda p: rows.why_included.str.contains(p, regex=False).map({True: 'yes', False: 'no'}).values
t = pd.DataFrame({
    'time (UTC)': rows.report_date_utc.str[11:19].values,
    'address match': has('Related data source or exact task identifier'),
    'outside list': has('externally selected research-activity cohort'),
    'intermediary': has('uses an intermediary or publishes task material'),
    'code': has('Supplied task-specific code'),
    'confidence': rows.confidence.values,
}).set_index('time (UTC)')
t
